zoe_onboard: Heads-up — onboarding for NorthSky (org=northsky-prod) stalled. iOS cold-starts spawn many background workers; we see concentrated 429s on preflight during app startup.

lina_cs: App/SDK versions? QA only or user-visible?

zoe_onboard: NorthSky-iOS v2.7.1, sdk=ios@0.9.8. Repro on simulator farm (50 sims). Each process does ~3 feature token fetches in parallel (analytics/chat/embed). First 1-2 succeed, others 429.

nate_eng: Sounds like token-fanout. Quick plan: client-side singleflight to dedupe preflight per process, add jittered exponential backoff honoring Retry-After, and increase local token TTL to avoid immediate re-preflight. Also stagger simulator starts by 200–500ms.

nate_eng: Swift singleflight sketch:
```
let lock = NSLock()
var cached: String?
func preflightOnce() async throws -> String {
  lock.lock()
  if let t = cached { lock.unlock(); return t }
  lock.unlock()
  let token = try await preflight()
  lock.lock(); cached = token; lock.unlock()
  return token
}
```

lina_cs: Also ask them to bump process cache TTL to 60s and gate concurrent feature inits to 1–2.

morgan_infra: We can raise preflight burst allowance temporarily. I can open a 3h window if they need it.

zoe_onboard: Please — +3x burst for 3h starting now would let them finish staged rollout. We'll stagger restarts.

morgan_infra: Window scheduled 2026-04-05T17:03:00Z -> 2026-04-05T20:03:00Z, change id nsq-20260405-02. ops_bot will post.

ops_bot: quota-adjustment applied change_id=nsq-20260405-02 org=northsky-prod window_start=2026-04-05T17:03:00Z window_end=2026-04-05T20:03:00Z actor=morgan_infra :white_check_mark:

zoe_onboard: Implementing singleflight + TTL change and will stagger sims by 300ms. Kicking in ~10m and will report results.

lina_cs: If failures persist after window, capture request trace ids and a short HAR/pcap for root cause. Also check metrics sdk.preflight.requests by device+second to confirm burst profile.

nate_eng: Tip: honor X-Rate-Limit-* headers and avoid parallel token refresh; gate refresh with singleflight so only one inflight refresh per host.

zoe_onboard: Thanks all — reporting back after canary :thumbsup:
